output.summary: The user requires at least 40% precision (genuine fraud rate among suspended accounts) to enable auto-suspension. The packet provides a 10% base rate, 95% sensitivity, and 99.4% specificity. Calculating the expected outcomes: True Positives = 1,000 * 0.95 = 950. False Positives = 9,000 * (1 - 0.994) = 9,000 * 0.006 = 54. Total Suspensions = 950 + 54 = 1,004. The precision is 950 / 1,004 ≈ 94.6%. Since 94.6% is significantly higher than the 40% threshold, the constraint is satisfied.
key_claims: Calculated precision is ~94.6% (950 true positives / 1,004 total suspensions)
False positive count is 54 (0.6% of 9,000 legitimate accounts)
True positive count is 950 (95% of 1,000 fraudulent accounts)
